question_text: Outline how a foreign-key constraint can preserve integrity when a loan record refers to a museum member.
adaptation_rationale: Narrows a broad old integrity-strategy question to relational integrity explicitly within A3.1.1.
solution: It requires the referenced member ID to exist in MEMBER, preventing a loan from referring to a nonexistent member.

marking_points.criterion: Requires an existing referenced member key.
Explains prevention of orphan/misattributed loan data.
